parole.significato: A place name suffix found in parts of former East Germany (or along the former border, as in Lüchow).
parole.testo: From native West Slavic languages, such as Polabian. Chiefly through Middle Low German; in originally High German areas the same Slavic suffix usually yields -au. Compare Russian -ов (-ov), Polish -ów, Serbo-Croatian -ov, etc.
